fork_open_pull_requests.title: Extend Word and Excel VBA with explicit Variants and paragraph macros
fork_open_pull_requests.head: codex/vba-variant-conversions-20261120
fork_open_pull_requests.body:
## Why

The next VBA roadmap slice needs explicit missing/unassigned values and predictable conversions while preserving the source-to-plan transaction boundary.

## Changes

- Add distinct Empty/Null states, Variant defaults, predicates and bounded CVar/CBool/CDbl/CLng/CStr conversions.
- Add eager Null semantics, ties-to-even Long conversion, invariant numeric parsing/formatting, native Empty clears and Null publication refusal.
- Add independently authored versioned conformance cases plus a runnable report and runtime/MCP/CLI tests.
- Reconcile current Zotero, Mail, PPTX and grammar work with original ancestry; repair picture-background ownership and repeated saves.

## Qualification in progress

Incremental source and evidence checkpoints are saved on this retained branch. Focused development tests and initial VM/JavaScript parity passed. Independent review found nested nullable-expression composition and scalar-Variant/object-checking gaps; fixes and combined-source qualification are in progress. Further remote advances are being reconciled before the final local gate.

No GitHub Actions, workflow runs, checks or commit-status endpoints are queried or awaited. Final exact local selections, source identities, raw receipts and limitations will be recorded before merging.

See docs/validation/office-vba-variant-conversions-20261120/README.md for the evolving evidence record.

fork_open_pull_requests.title: Rename built app artifacts and platform identities to CrispOffice
fork_open_pull_requests.head: feat/crispoffice-rename-20261120
fork_open_pull_requests.body:
Renames the built app artifacts and platform identities to **CrispOffice**. The UI already said CrispOffice; the builds did not. Dart package names (`quds_office_studio`, `package:` imports) and internal identifiers are unchanged.

## What changed
- **macOS**: `PRODUCT_NAME = CrispOffice` → `CrispOffice.app`, executable `CrispOffice`, menu/About name CrispOffice (MainMenu.xib `APP_NAME` placeholders too), bundle id `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice` (RunnerTests `.RunnerTests`), copyright `© 2026 CrispStrobe`. The pbxproj product reference, TEST_HOST and scheme BuildableName were updated to match.
- **iOS**: bundle id `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice`, CFBundleName/DisplayName `CrispOffice` (the executable stays `Runner`, the Flutter iOS convention).
- **Android**: `applicationId` and `namespace` `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice`, `MainActivity` moved to that package, label `CrispOffice`.
- **Linux**: binary `crispoffice`, application id `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice`, window title CrispOffice. **Windows**: `CrispOffice.exe`, window/version resource strings CrispOffice, company CrispStrobe.
- **Web**: `apple-mobile-web-app-title` set to CrispOffice. Title and manifest were already CrispOffice.
- `tool/build_macos_app.sh` produces `CrispOffice.app`; all of its verification is unchanged. Signed modes still copy to `build/macos/signed/CrispOffice.app`, and `QUDS_APP_NAME`/`QUDS_BUNDLE_ID` still override the signed copy only.
- Gate test headers and the spaCy gate's executable path, `studio_native_paths_test`, workflows `macos-app-weekly.yml` and `crispoffice-binaries.yml`.
- The sample-PDF kickers in the Studio gallery change from `QUDS OFFICE` to `CRISPOFFICE`. The About attribution to the MIT Quds Office engine stays.
- `docs/release/macos-signing.md` and the example README: every build now uses the new id. They give the old-container `ditto` command and the consequences listed below.
- CI: a `workflow_dispatch` trigger plus a dispatch-only `studio_example` job that runs the full Studio example suite on macOS.

## Consequences
- The sandbox container is now `~/Library/Containers/com.crispstrobe.crispoffice`. Test data from `com.quds.qudsOfficeStudio` builds (dictionaries, Camel Morph DB, spaCy models, ribbon prefs, mail archive) has to be downloaded again, or copied once with `ditto`. The data folder name inside the container (`quds_office_studio`) is unchanged.
- Saved mail accounts (`flutter_secure_storage`, key `crispoffice.mail.account.v1`) are keychain items owned by the old app identity. They are orphaned and must be entered again. The service and key names do not come from the bundle id.
- On iOS and Android the app installs as a new app beside old development builds.
- There are no App Groups or keychain access-group entitlements to update.

## Validation
- `dart analyze packages apps`: 0 errors and 0 warnings (infos only).
- `build_macos_app.sh` (ad hoc) produced `CrispOffice.app` with CFBundleName/DisplayName/Executable `CrispOffice`, id `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice` and copyright `© 2026 CrispStrobe`. `codesign --verify --deep --strict` is valid, and the spaCy library is qualified (code digest).
- `studio_spacy_bundle_native_gate.dart` and `studio_macos_bundle_native_gate.dart` pass with a scratch `QUDS_STUDIO_DATA`.
- The Android debug APK has package `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice`, label `CrispOffice` and launchable `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice.MainActivity`.
- The iOS simulator build has `com.crispstrobe.crispoffice` and name/display name CrispOffice.
- Targeted Studio tests for the changed files pass. The full Studio suite runs in GitHub Actions through workflow_dispatch (the local machine was overloaded).

fork_open_pull_requests.title: Qualify manual German grammar on the Android arm64 spaCy library
fork_open_pull_requests.head: feat/android-spacy-grammar-20261120
fork_open_pull_requests.body:
Manual de-DE grammar is now qualified for the exact Android arm64-v8a library in the Studio APK (`ed730f62…`), using the protocol from the macOS qualification. The library was reproduced byte-exact from its pins.

**On-device replay** (Android 16 arm64 emulator, Studio host `openGrammarTransport()`, mask 15), compared with the retained Linux/macOS results:
- W6: 22/30 native/combined exact vs 5/30 deterministic, 0 valid/guard findings, **0 case / 0 summary differences**, 108 annotations.
- W7: 24/40 vs 14/40, 0 valid/guard findings, **0 / 0**, 120 annotations.
- v2 panel + 977 GSD test sentences: **0 annotation differences** across 1,283 digests. The qualified families match the record: np-agreement 13, preposition-case 18, verb-position 9 of 24; 0 valid/guard findings; the same 2 corpus findings. There are 7 planner-row differences, all from the post-qualification subject-person guard (an experimental family). They were measured first on the qualified macOS library with the same source and pinned in the test.
- Android rows equal the macOS control rows on every field (W6 796, W7 888, v2 14,958 fields; 0 differences).

**Identity:** ELF has no embedded signature, so the identity is the whole-file SHA-256 (no code digest). The digest is added to `spacyGrammarNativeSha256s`; the code-digest set is unchanged. The grammar claim is in `spacyRecordedBuilds`, so Studio's "Manual German grammar suggestions" is now offered on Android.

**iOS:** no claim. The simulator bytes are not the device bytes, and no device was available ([ios.md](docs/validation/native-spacy-android-grammar-20261120/ios.md)).

**Tools:** `grammar_replay_core.dart` is the shared replay loop (desktop CLIs and the device test). Also `replay_grammar_v2.dart`, `grammar_replay_server.py`, `compare_replay_rows.py` and the `android-spacy-grammar.yml` dispatch workflow. Evidence: `docs/validation/native-spacy-android-grammar-20261120/`.

**Validation:** quds_proofing_spacy `dart test` 114 passed. Studio spaCy tests 57 passed. `dart analyze packages apps` shows 0 errors/warnings. The mobile gate with the new grammar step did not complete locally (the Mac was overloaded and emulator work was moved to CI). The GitHub arm64 runners have no KVM, so the CI gate runs on x86_64 bytes only, with no claim for them.
